season.evidence: Ascent histogram peaks Jul-Oct (Jul 212, Aug 180, Sep 152, Oct 122, Jun 97 across all routes); web search of club trip reports points to roughly mid-June through October for the PCT-based scramble, with spring snow lingering in some years and winter needing a separate snow route. Matches stored Jun-Oct.

track.why: 11 Jun 2026, successful summit, round trip 10 mi / 2800 ft from the PCT north trailhead (17 m from our pin), summit 4 m from our pin. Report describes a cruiser PCT then a class 2 scree scramble to the summit, which is our stored line. The catalog holds only one scramble route on the peak (the other is a WI3+ ice route on the cliff) and the track follows this route's described PCT then boot-path line. June is the first month of the stored season.

facts.text: In mid-June, patches of snow begin around 4,800 ft on the PCT and the turnoff to the boot path may be buried; poles and microspikes help until the trees thin out, and a short snow traverse near the top can be skirted along the rocks.
microspikes (late October, fresh snow on the summit trail and scree traverse)
Late October snow on loose, chossy summit-trail rock; large groups wear helmets
Leaving the PCT too early near the end of the ridge lands you on loose scree above the busy PCT; keep going to the true boot path

notes: The packet held one route (the scramble); the ice route Kendall Cliff North Face (WI3+) has no applicable tracks. Many ascents share the same PCT line; only one assigned. Trailhead pin already stored; no pin proposals.
